_: Where named major roads MEET, as a record (decision 0068): `solve_major_routes` routes every road listed on a junction through its position, so a crossroads is a design fact and not an accident of two independent solves. `positionM` is metres [east, south] in the province frame. Each entry carries a lore `why`. Add a junction only where the meeting point is itself a world fact (a crossroads settlement, a toll point, a pass); two roads that merely share a corridor need no entry. A `pin` is the same record with one road: a point the owner steered that road through (a river crossing, a mountain-foot lowland, an approach side); the router honours pins in start-to-goal order.

junctions.why: The owner-specified west-east trunk (Archon-Gideon) and the heartland-to-south chain (Helstrom-Blackrose) cross here on dry, slightly higher ground; all Archon-Helstrom and Gideon-Helstrom travel runs through this junction and no direct road exists (owner decisions 2026-08-22 and 2026-09-15, position corrected by the owner 2026-09-16; settlement-anchors.json notes). The community map's 'Crossroads' settlement is a prior for a place here, to be decided in the 16g plot.
